functions.name: distanceToEdge
functions.signature: float distanceToEdge (Edge *e, float x, float y);
functions.purpose: Return the distance from a point to the closest point on an edge segment.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses float arithmetic for the projection and squared distance, then calls the C library sqrt with a double argument and converts the result to float. A zero-length edge causes division by zero; NaNs and rounding near the segment endpoints affect clamping.

functions.name: fixEdgeBetweenVertices
functions.purpose: Fix a connection between two vertices, creating edges and retriangulating adjacent regions as needed.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Its static helpers traverse and mutate mesh topology, use float intersection and cotangent calculations with exact comparisons, and recursively retriangulate; near-degenerate geometry and traversal order can change the resulting mesh. Helpers also call vertexBetweenVertices, killEdge, and circumTri, and invoke model callbacks.

functions.name: unfixEdge
functions.purpose: Unfix an interior edge and restore the surrounding triangulation.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The recursive helper tests circumcircle membership and swaps edges, so float boundary decisions and traversal order can change topology; it calls inCircumTri, killEdge, makeEdgeFace, and circumTri and invokes model callbacks.

functions.name: inCircum
functions.signature: int inCircum (float x, float y, float xc, float yc, float rs);
functions.purpose: Test whether a point lies strictly inside a circumcircle.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses float squared distances with an early comparison and a special exact comparison against TRI_INFINITY; points on the circle are excluded, and rounding near the boundary affects the result.

functions.name: inCircumTri
functions.signature: int inCircumTri (float x, float y, Tri *t);
functions.purpose: Test whether a point lies strictly inside a triangle's circumcircle.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Inherits inCircum's float boundary comparisons and TRI_INFINITY handling.

functions.name: in3Vertices
functions.signature: int in3Vertices (float x, float y, Vertex *v1, Vertex *v2, Vertex *v3);
functions.purpose: Test whether a point lies within the triangle defined by three vertices.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Computes float cross products and compares their products to zero; rounding, underflow, and degeneracy affect classification. Despite the comment saying edges are inside, the <= 0 tests exclude points exactly on an edge.

functions.name: inTri
functions.signature: int inTri (float x, float y, Tri *t);
functions.purpose: Test whether a point lies within a triangle using its three vertices.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Inherits in3Vertices' float cross-product behavior, including exclusion of exact edge points despite the comment.

functions.name: nearestEdgeInModel
functions.signature: Edge* nearestEdgeInModel (Model *m, Edge *start, float x, float y);
functions.purpose: Find the nearest edge among the edges of the triangle containing a point.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Compares float distances in edge traversal order and retains the first edge on ties; triangle-location and distance calculations can affect choices near boundaries.

functions.name: nearestVertexInModel
functions.signature: Vertex* nearestVertexInModel (Model *m, Vertex *start, float x, float y);
functions.purpose: Find a nearest vertex by repeatedly moving to a closer adjacent vertex.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Iteratively compares float squared distances; strict comparison and adjacency traversal order determine tie behavior, while rounding can change the path or selected vertex.

functions.name: projectToEdge
functions.purpose: Project a point onto the closest point of an edge segment in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses float arithmetic and clamps the projection parameter to the segment; a zero-length edge causes division by zero, and rounding near endpoints affects clamping.
